text: My wife and I met Heather at the Pink Bride show. When we saw her booth we knew we had to have her at our wedding. Entertainment for our guest and a forever keepsake.. we didn’t have to think twice! Working with Heather was so easy, which is a relief when planning a wedding. We spoke over the phone about our vision for the painting and she exceeded all of our expectations! Our guest loved watching her paint and even getting to add their touch to the canvas! At the end of the night we loved what she painted, but seeing the finished product a week or so later.. our jaws dropped and tears welled up in my wife’s eyes! Having it in our home allows us to relive the moment and it always brings a smile to our face. Stop now and book Heather for your wedding or have her paint from a photo, you won’t regret it!

owner_reply.text: Wow! Thank you so much for the kind words Jacob! It was an honor to be apart of your wedding day! I had a blast dancing to the great music while I painted (tell your dad he did a great job). The energy of the wedding was so happy and everyone was thrilled to see you and Alex make your forever promise. thank you again for having me be apart of you BIG day!🎨
